The hair is so soft and has minimal shedding when combed. It isn’t shinny & looks very natural. I also love the combs attached. It helps keep it securely in place. Absolutely recommend!

We had a Christmas party at my job and I wanted to have long hair for the night and for special occasions. This wig looked great, co workers kept telling me how real it looks. I have never used a wig before so I was skeptical on putting it on, which ended up being easy. Buy this product, you will not be disappointed

This is such a beautiful wig! The curls are so beautiful. The hair is soft. There are clips and neck straps to help hold the wig on better. Minimal shedding. Easy to brush out. I would say the wig looks like the reference image. Only thing is the part is a bit tighter than in the image. It is truly a beautiful wig and worth the buy.

So this might be long, it's a pretty decent wig for the money, it isnt shiny. Looks like real hair, how ever the part is a nightmare lmao. Oh boy. Let’s just say, it’s GORGEOUS but BIG. Make sure you know your face and who you are before buying. It’s so obnoxious on me! Lol. I am 5’4 and a natural brunette. I Bought this for fun. It’s heavy and just everywhere! I wouldn’t recommend it for a “real” hairstyle, because it’s quite large. But, it all depends on your face.

[[VIDEOID:1ad327f9f6083031d1ab18e0ee3281b2]] Y’all!!!! I am IMPRESSED!!!! I don’t typically go for wigs that aren’t lace front because they can look unrealistic. This wig blew me away!! The color, texture and shine helped making this wig look more natural and realistic!!!! I highly recommend this wig especially at the price point of it!!!! This wig makes me want to put highlights back in!!! I did a tangle test where I wear this wig around for a few hours! It didn’t tangle anymore than my natural

This wig was perfect! I used it for Halloween but I can see it being used as a natural wig for everyday use. My 2 complaint would be the parting of the wig hair. It doesn’t look like an actual part, but you can easily take some skin tone concealer to the root of it and blend to make it look like a part. This is just a little issue but it’s super shiny but a little dry shampoo took away the plastic look to it. Definitely recommend this wig!!!! It was a big hit

I bought this for work and I am SO happy with this purchase. I saw the reviews and knew I wanted one in blonde and another in black. It's perfect. Very long and thick. The hairline does look very fake, it's obviously not a wig meant for everyday wear. The hair is soft. It does tangle a little bit but thats as expected with any wig. Comb the wig out with your fingers and manipulate the curls a bit and BOOM. 💅 GORGEOUS!

reviews.t: Beautiful long wavy blond wig! Highly recommend it!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:4ffe184d2ff843f7041b9e878ad28327]] Wow! This is actually my first wig and I love it! It was delivered super fast and it did come with a wig cap. I was so nervous to put it in because I thought it was going to be hard. It was actually super easy to put on and I’m very happy with the quality! I would highly recommend it and I’m definitely going to be getting more.

I am in love with this wig. I can’t believe the price for such great quality, the color is perfect, it doesn’t look too shiny or fake. It actually looks like real hair. Able to brush without much hair loss. Just wish I would’ve started wearing wigs sooner, this wig looks fantastic. Highly recommend to anyone wanting to change their look for an affordable price! In love.

This was my first time purchasing a wig and I’m not mad it looks pretty darn cute! I’m Asian and I can work this wig pretty good hahaha. The only problems with this wig is it tangles and it bulges when you put on your head. I had to put a head band on in order to make it look natural. It has been a month and it tangles sooo much and is fuzzy.

reviews.t: Luscious locks and sassy.. love it!
reviews.x: I bought it just for fun and out of curiosity. Actually my very first wig. I'm totally impressed! Sure it will tangle after a few uses, but a quick spritz of leave in conditioner and it smooths out. I use it like a "fall" hair piece with my bobbed hair exposed at the bang & temples to blend in the hairline. Just like in my pic.

I bought this wig for fun and see I would look as a blonde, when it arrived, I tried it and the roots looked really fake, I had to wear a hat so people didn't notice them, also, I have a pretty small head so the elastic was either too loose or too tight. However, those were the only flaws on this products

Other wigs i've purchased around this price were more natural looking. It's very shiny and more poofy in the wrong places- crown and sides, perhaps because the waves started higher than usual for me. The front also raises more than usual. Good color and strands though with not too much shedding

Loved this wig because it’s so realistic even to the touch. I couldn’t keep it because I’m not used to the pressure or tightness around my head. It’s perfect for cosplay or even dressing up and going out one night. I wouldn’t suggest keeping a wig on all day. It was painful just for a few hrs.

It’s a lot better than I thought it would be for the price. They hit the jackpot on making this wig look natural, and it’s soft! It stays on my head really well too. The middle part doesn’t suit me very good so I added a hat and it fixed that problem. Awesome wig!

Super soft and very voluminous. The color is really nice. The length and the curled ends look too perfect to be very realistic and the part is extremely thick. With a hat on or a headband concealing the hairline/part area, this wig looks less wiggy.

This wig is gorgeous! It looks so natural. It feels soft and comfortable. I could wear it every day. I wanted to see what my hair looked like with the ombre style and part down the middle. It makes me feel pretty and glamorous. I absolutely love it!

The blonde color is stunning, but the root color is odd and doesn't blend like the product image. I love the length and the texture. I use this wig often when my natural hair isn't cutting it. I would recommend styling it with a hat :)

This wig was purchased for a birthday party. I was impressed by how soft the hair is and how awesome the middle part is. People who didn't know me genuinely though it was my real hair. I would definitely recommend this wig!

This wig is actually super cute! It’s surprisingly comfortable and combs out into beautiful loose waves! The hairline isn’t the most realistic but of course it was only $20, and definitely worth the price!
This is a super thick wig and colors are true to the images on here. My complaint is the top / roots looks very fake. Like, EXTREMELY fake. Worse than Barbie hair. I wouldn’t wear this without a hat.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig's quality and natural, realistic appearance for the price.
Many note the hair is soft and easy to manage, with minimal shedding and easy brushing.
The parting/hairline is a common complaint, described as looking fake or wiggy and needing concealer or plucking to fix.
Some reviewers find the wig large, heavy, or prone to tangling and bulging.
A few reviewers report the product does not match the description, such as not being a true lace front.
